name: Amp Puck
desc: Assistant inside Amp that starts and steers work on your behalf.
desc_zh: Amp 里替你发起并推进工作的助手。
solves: Every task still starts with you writing the prompt; Puck takes the intent, opens sessions and keeps several moving at once.
solves_zh: 每个任务仍要你自己写提示词；Puck 接过意图，开会话并让多个任务同时推进。
best_for: You have a rough goal and would rather delegate the framing as well as the work.
best_for_zh: 只有一个粗略目标，想把任务的拆解也一起交出去。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ampcode.com/chronicle news feed）。 Named in-product surface. Puck later became reachable over MCP (2026-10-13) and on mobile (2026-11-21). 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Puck」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://ampcode.com/news/meet-puck
